text:
maria: Hey team — tagging everyone for the joint webinar with CloudFlow next Thurs. Two coordination points that are sticky: accessible demo capture (live captions + post-event captioned recording) and swag return logistics for the partner-run hardware kits. Need a quick plan today so we can include in the runbook.

aj: For captions we should confirm whether CloudFlow will provide live captions. If not, I can spin up Otter.ai live captions and feed to the stream. Does Redwood cover the vendor cost? :thinking_face:

maria: Good Q. CloudFlow said they'd try, but not confirmed. I'd budget for us to provide fallback. Can you estimate cost and latency impact? Also need captioning for the VOD (SRT or VTT).

aj: Estimate: Otter live captions ~$120/session + VOD export to VTT. Latency ~5s. I'll write the vendor fallback note in the runbook.

samir: On demo capture — remind: the hands-on demo uses a two-screen setup (app UI + GPU box camera). We should do an AV capture plan:
```
- capture1: browser tab (screen share) 1080p@30
- capture2: hardware camera (USB 60fps) 720p for close-up
- combined: OBS scene record + separate audio track
```
Make sure we create a separate recording of the shell logs (cat /var/log/demo.log) for postmortem.

katie: Speakers: we still need 1-sentence bios + headshots + their slides by Tue EOD. Also request accessibility notes (e.g., color contrast, alt text for images) from each speaker so captions/slide transcript team can prep.

pavel: For hardware kits: partner wants to ship 12 loaner boxes to our SF office. Logistics: who receives, who returns, and who pays customs if one gets rerouted? My suggestion: ship to Ops@redwood with a return label inside the box pre-paid to CloudFlow. Partners hate hassle on returns.

jenna: I can own inbound/outbound swag logistics. Two asks: (1) customs paperwork copy to send to partner; (2) return label template (we can include printable return label in sleeve). Also confirm whether stickers/t-shirt inventory stays with partner or we distribute and collect post-event.

maria: Perfect. Action items so far: AJ = caption vendor fallback & cost; Samir = OBS capture checklist + demo log export; Katie = collect bios/headshots/access notes; Jenna = inbound/outbound swag plan + return label template; Pavel = customs point-of-contact + shipping ETA. I'll add to runbook and schedule a dry-run Thurs (3pm PT) with CloudFlow.

aj: Dry-run noted. Also recommend we add a quick checklist item to test captions in the dry-run: 1) trigger speaker audio 2) check live captions visible in stream UI 3) validate VTT export.

samir: For demo fallback: if GPU box overheats or there's network problems, fallback plan: use recorded demo video (60s clip) or switch to a hosted API call with the same prompt. I'll upload the clip to the shared drive before dry-run.

jenna: Return label template (example) below — I'll attach actual PDF to the runbook, but here's the text to include inside the box: 
```
Return to: CloudFlow Inc.
Attn: Hardware Returns
CloudFlow Returns Dept
123 Marketplace Rd
San Jose, CA 95134
RMA: CF-RED-3422
Prepaid: Yes (UPS) - see enclosed label.pdf
```
Also note: for international shipments include CN22/CBP forms per country.

maria: Recording-bot — after dry-run can you post the rehearsal recording link and the caption VTT when ready?

recording-bot: rehearsal recording will be available at https://internal.rec/redwood/3422101111-rehearsal once upload completes. VTT export will be attached within 12 hours of finalizing captions. :white_check_mark:

katie: One more item — accessibility moderator: can we assign someone to field live accessibility questions (raised via Q&A) and confirm alt-text for shared slides? I can recruit from DEI volunteers.

maria: Love that — Katie assign please and add contact to runbook.

aj: I'll join the dry-run and own caption verification.

pavel: Logistics note: schedule courier pickup 2 days after event for returns to avoid customs backlog. I'll coordinate with Jenna.

maria: Great team — I'll push an updated runbook PR by EOD with these owners. If anyone has objections to vendor choice or shipping flow, shout now. Otherwise I'll lock the plan at 6pm PT. :lock:
